mentions.name: kiln
mentions.description: This tool manages encrypted environment variables for teams. Variables are encrypted with age, protected by RBAC access control, and come with a development workflow for running ad-hoc commands, exporting, and templating that integrates into CI/CD and local development. Encrypted secrets are stored in Git so everything is version-controlled in a single place.
mentions.problem: Existing tools like age and SOPS lack good UX around encryption for team-based workflows; CI vars don't support local deploys, and tools like Vault are painful to manage.
mentions.audience: Teams, with a developer-first experience for large teams
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an encrypted environment variables management tool, called kiln[1], for teams.
